name: Love, Death and PvP
source: From average high schooler to powerful hero—you've just become a member of the strongest party in the newest VRMMORPG, Inferno, after accidentally kill-stealing from one of the most powerful players. Join forces with a selfish but strong dark knight, a kind mage who tends to go overboard, and a self-proclaimed treasure hunter with social anxiety, and embark on a journey to defeat the final boss!
translation: 从普通的高中生到强大的英雄——在不小心从最强大的玩家之一那里偷杀后，你刚刚成为最新VRMMORPG《Inferno》中最强队伍的一员。与自私却坚强的黑暗骑士、容易走极端的善良法师、患有社交焦虑症的自称宝藏猎人联手，踏上击败最终boss的旅程！
